pairs.why: The two robots are almost identical; A's slightly softer, closer framing reads a touch more like the real cards, but this is close to a tie.
This is the same near-identical robot pair as q016, so I kept the same slight lean to A for consistency.

B's helmet has a side stripe and a studded neck ring that make it look like a more convincingly built object, with polish closer to the real cards, while A's chin button makes it look a bit more like a plain toy.
A is the same striped, studded helmet that won q018; it is more believably built and finished like the real cards than B's simpler helmet with a chin button.
A's clean, softly lit helmet matches the real cards' even finish better than B, whose visor is slightly flattened and whose darker, higher-contrast blue trim feels a bit off-style.
B's soft, even rendering fits the real cards better than A's higher-contrast version with the odd flattened visor.
A is well built and has moderate detail with soft gloss, like the real cards; B's darker trim and flattened visor read slightly less like the game.
B is the striped helmet with a studded ring; its build and finish are closest to the real cards, while A's visor is flattened and its trim is heavier.
